title: Surgical Isolation of Stellate Ganglia and Electrophysiology
author: Mark Doyle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bb4riqv6
materials: Right and left stellate ganglia, Rostral Ansa, and iCN were identified, traced to the heart and separated from surrounding tissue using a high magnification (250x-400x) stereo microscope. Ganglia with at least 3mm of outflow nerves were carefully transferred to a custom recording chamber and treated with 0.7 mg /ml Collagenase Type 2, (Sigma Aldrich) and 0.3mg/ml Collagenase Type 1 (Worthington Biochemical) dissolved into oxygenated Leibowitz, supplemented culture media, L-15 (Thermo-Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Prepare and Perfuse Heart and Stellate Ganglia
steps.instruction: Remove the thorax of adult mice (either sex) under deep Isoflurane anesthesia. Perfuse the heart and stellate ganglia (SG) with modified Ringers solution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare external recording solution containing: 146mM NaCl, 4.7mM KCl, 0.13mM NaH2PO4, 0.6mM MgSO4, 1.6mM NaHCO3, 2.0mM CaCl2, 7.8mM D-glucose, and 20mM Hepes.
Adjust solution to pH 7.31 with NaOH and 300mOsm.

steps.title: Position Ganglia and Clear Connective Tissue
steps.instruction: Position the ganglia (RA/iCN) in the recording chamber and remove connective tissue.

substeps.instruction: Weight down ganglia with a custom Teflon coated platinum harp with non-fluorescent angled strands.
Direct a gentle stream of 100% O2 over the chamber to circulate enzyme solution and loosen tissue.

After approximately one hour in enzyme solution, tease away remaining connective tissue using extra fine ceramic Dumont #55 forceps or suction using a custom glass Furst Baron Suction Tube (0.3mm inner diameter).
Avoid touching or damaging the nerves.

steps.title: Transfer to Imaging System
steps.instruction: Transfer the recording chamber to a Zeiss Axioskop 2, FS Mot microscope.

substeps.instruction: Use a 40X water immersion objective, epifluorescence, and Differential Interference Contrast (DIC) optics.
Capture images using a SPOT Pursuit Camera with Spot Imaging Solutions software.

steps.title: Position Stimulating Electrodes
steps.instruction: Place two ultra-fine platinum Iridium, concentric bipolar stimulating electrodes (Fredriech Heare) on isolated nerve trunks, as far from the ganglia as possible.

substeps.instruction: Ensure electrodes have a 25 µM inner pole and a 50 µm outer pole diameter.

steps.title: Configure Stimulation Parameters
steps.instruction: Use a Master 9 programmable stimulator and Iso-Flex optical isolation unit (AMPI industries) to recruit and isolate single synaptic inputs.

substeps.instruction: Apply constant current square wave stimuli ranging from 10-1500 µA.
Set pulse durations between 40 to 100uSec.
Set stimulus train inter-pulse intervals from 100 mSec to 6 Sec.

steps.title: Prepare Patch Pipettes
steps.instruction: Pull patch pipettes from 5251 borosilicate glass (WPI) to a final tip resistance of 2.5-4.0 M.Ohms and fill with internal solution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare internal solution: 94mM K-gluconate, 30mM KCl, 10mM Phosphocreatine, 10mM Hepes, 0.2mM EGTA, 4mM MgATP, and 0.3mM Na2GTP.
Adjust pH to 7.31 using Tris buffer.
Adjust final osmolarity to 290mOsm using D-Glucose.
Optional: Add Neurobiotin 5 mg/ml (Vector Laboratories) for axonal/dendrite anatomy; if added, correct D-Glucose concentration using a vapor pressure osmometer (Wescor) to maintain 290 mOSM.

steps.title: Perform Electrophysiological Recordings
steps.instruction: Identify labeled neurons using epifluorescent optics and maneuver pipettes under DIC visualization.

substeps.instruction: Maintain positive pressure on the pipette to inflate the glial cell covering and establish a 1.2-3.5 giga-ohm seal on the neuronal membrane.
Sample voltage and current clamp recordings at 20 kHz using a Multiclamp 700B amplifier and pClamp 9.2 software.
Calculate and apply junction potentials using pClamp algorithms.
Calculate and correct pipette capacitance before and after each recording.
Apply series resistance compensation during voltage clamp protocols requiring membrane steps.

steps.title: Recover Ganglia for Analysis
steps.instruction: Following recording, recover the ganglia for confocal analysis.

substeps.instruction: Cool bath temperature from 32 degrees to 26 degrees for 10 minutes.
Apply very slight positive pressure to the pipette to separate it from the neurolemma without tearing.
Take reference photographs of the cell 5 minutes after electrode removal to verify soma integrity and cell position.

steps.title: Fix and Store Ganglia
steps.instruction: Transfer the recording chamber back to the surgical microscope and preserve the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Remove the retaining harp.
Transfer ganglia and attached nerves into 4% Paraformaldehyde (PFA) as quickly as possible.
Flash fix using 2450 MHz, 600 KiloWatt microwave irradiation for 5 seconds.
Rinse in 9% Phosphate Buffered Saline.
Store in high concentration sucrose storage solution at -20 degrees.
